offering_description.value: Provides software and tech-enabled services for regulatory filings, compliance and financial reporting, mainly to public companies, asset managers and other financial institutions. Delivers via cloud software platforms for SEC filings, deal workflows and fund compliance, plus print and filing services.

primary_products.value: regulatory filing and reporting software; virtual data room software; investment company compliance software; deal and transaction software; printed regulatory documents

primary_services.value: EDGAR filing and XBRL tagging; regulatory document composition and typesetting; translation services; document printing and distribution; compliance reporting support

customer_segment.value: B2B: public companies, asset managers, mutual funds, investment banks, law firms, private equity firms

end_markets.value: financial services; asset management; capital markets; corporate legal and compliance; investment banking

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring software platform subscriptions for compliance and data rooms; transaction or usage fees: event-driven fees for filings, deals and transactions; service fees: filing, typesetting and translation services; product sales: printed compliance and regulatory documents
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud software for regulatory compliance and deal workflows, sold to corporations and financial firms; service provider: takes in client content and delivers filings, typesetting, translation and print to issuers and funds

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Canada, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: software solutions for capital markets, investment companies and compliance, plus tech-enabled filing and print services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to corporations, asset managers, banks and law firms; online: cloud platforms accessed by clients online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: products support SEC and other securities regulatory filings, company faces data privacy and security rules
